findings.evidence: Both proofs establish the same `hpad` equality from `nilpotencyClass ≤ d`, expand `Finset.range d`, and identify coefficient matrices; the respective cutoffs are 2 at lines 476–498 and 3 at lines 535–565.
findings.fix: Prove a theorem for arbitrary `d` and matrices representing every integral divided power below `d`, expressing the result as a finite matrix sum; derive the square- and cube-zero formulas as specializations.
findings.issue: `kostantRootSubgroupMatrix_eq_one_add_smul_add_smul` duplicates the pointwise truncation proof of `kostantRootSubgroupMatrix_eq_one_add_smul` at line 462, differing only by cutoff three and one additional coefficient matrix.

summary: The divided-power and lattice APIs are now generalized, but the matrix formula still duplicates the square-zero proof at cutoff three instead of deriving both cases from the natural finite-nilpotency statement.
